 South Carolina's Dylan Stewart projected in top five of 2027 NFL Draft
 Kevin Miller @ kevinmillerGC 10/23/26 1 Share Share 
 South Carolina EDGE rusher Dylan Stewart is one of the top NFL Draft prospects in college football. That fact was reiterated this week, as ESPN’s Field Yates released his updated mock draft ahead of next spring’s festivities.
 According to Yates, the Gamecock star could come off the board at No. 5 overall. The draft analyst lists Stewart as the fifth pick of the first round to the Washington Commanders.
 If taken by Washington, Stewart would join former Gamecock Javon Kinlaw in the defensive line room.
 In Yates’ projection, Stewart is the second EDGE (behind Texas’ Colin Simmons) selected. He is also the third defensive player (behind Notre Dame cornerback Leonard Moore and Simmons) picked. 
 If Yates’ mock draft proves to be prophetic, Stewart would be the third Gamecock ever to earn top-five selection. George Rogers (first overall to the New Orleans Saints in 1981) and Jadeveon Clowney (first overall to the Houston Texans in 2014) are the others.
 Have a South Carolina football question for the GamecockCentral staff? Ask it now on The Insiders Forum. 
 Said Yates about Stewart and the Commanders:
 “The Commanders spent big in free agency to land edge rusher Odafe Oweh, but they are still struggling to impact opposing quarterbacks. So far in 2026, they’re 25th in sacks per dropback (4.5%) and 20th in pass rush win rate (48.2%).
 “The best version of Stewart has a case for the top pass rusher in the class, as he’s incredibly explosive, powerful, long, and hell on wheels to try to block. But teams will have some questions about a recent one-game suspension for punching an Alabama player in the helmet and arguing with coaches on the sideline.
 “Stewart is immensely talented, but he must harness that skill and find a way for those physical traits to translate into straight production. He has one sack this season and 12 over the past three years.”
 What’s your NFL Draft prediction for Dylan Stewart? Share it with fellow subscribers on The Insiders Forum.
